# IkiHomes

> IkiHomes (ikihomescr.com) is a real estate marketplace in Costa Rica. Buyers and renters search
> homes, condos, lots and commercial properties listed by local real estate agents, and every
> agent's verification badges and response times are shown on their listings and profile.
> The site is in Spanish, with an English version.

## For buyers and renters
- Search properties for sale and for rent in all seven provinces. Searching is free.
- Contact the listing agent by WhatsApp, message or visit request.
- "Buscá por mí" (Find my home): describe what you are looking for and agents reply with options.
- Buyer data is not sold; the buyer chooses when and with whom to talk.

## For real estate agents
- Free plan: US$0, a public agent profile, up to 10 published listings at a time and unlimited drafts.
- Realtor Pro: US$49 per month. Online purchase is not open yet; today Realtor Pro is activated by writing to soporte@ikihomescr.com.
- Buyer requests ("Buscá por mí"): only Realtor Pro agents can respond, and only the first three valid responses per request are accepted.
- [For agents](https://www.ikihomescr.com/es/para-agentes)
- [Where to publish properties in Costa Rica, guide in Spanish](https://www.ikihomescr.com/es/blog/donde-publicar-propiedades-costa-rica)
- Agent portal: https://app.ikihomescr.com
